messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding helios-6b to the eval harness. CI eval shows a big drop in the conversational-fluency metric after the quant-8 run :confused:
akash: ugh, can you paste the failing log lines or the diff? :eyes:
ci-bot: [eval-runner] test_eval_pipeline::helios6b_quant8 — FAILED (conv-fluency: 0.18 -> 0.12, p<0.01)
maria: log excerpt:
```
[2024-07-10 14:12:03] INFO  runner: starting eval pipeline
[2024-07-10 14:12:07] WARN  preprocess: detokenize mismatch on sample 12345
expected: "I'm fine."
actual:   "I 'm fine."
metric delta contributed by sample: -0.0042
```
sophie: that detokenize spacing looks like a tokenizer normalization mismatch rather than model perf. which tokenizer version was used for quant build?
liam: quick check: quant variant was built with tokenizer v2.3, baseline used v2.1 — we've seen whitespace/quote merging differences between those before.
akash: ok, next steps: (1) repro locally with the exact tokenizer pair, (2) run eval with detokenize normalization forced, (3) check dashboard diffs. maria can you run step 1?
maria: running now. command I'm using: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model helios-6b --variant quant8 --tokenizer v2.3 --suite conv-fluency --limit 200`
ci-bot: queued job 9843 (eval-helm / helios6b / quant8)
akash: also inspect our detokenize hook at `eval_runner/preproc/detokenize.py` — we recently changed curly-quote handling in v2.3 which adds a space in some merges.
sophie: quick hotfix idea: normalize quotes + collapse stray spaces before metric compute, e.g. `text = re.sub(r"\\s+(['\"])", r"\\1", text)` then re-eval small sample.
liam: note: if we mask normalization in harness we might hide real regressions. prefer to align tokenizer versions or snapshot tokenizer artifacts in the eval run config.
maria: agreed. I'll open a short-lived PR that snapshots tokenizer v2.1 for the control run and a second job that applies the normalization patch so we can compare both. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/3482
akash: add a unit test that asserts detokenize(normalize(tokenize(x))) roundtrips on a handful of conv examples. saves future flakiness.
sophie: add a metric-level tag in the dashboard so we can filter regressions caused by preprocess diffs vs model outputs. puts the blame where it belongs.
maria: local run done — with tokenizer v2.1 baseline the conv-fluency stays at 0.18; with v2.3 it drops to 0.12. repro successful. attaching quick diff (small):
```
- I'm fine.
+ I 'm fine.
```
maria: I'm going to: (A) push PR that pins tokenizer for the control, (B) push normalization patch behind a flag, (C) add unit test. will trigger CI rerun `rerun-ci --job eval-helm --id 9843` afterwards.
liam: +1. if CI agrees we can decide whether to upgrade tokenizer across all pipelines or keep snapshotting per-model.
akash: thanks team. moving this to a follow-up sprint item if CI passes. :thumbsup:
maria: will update the incident channel and the conv-fluency dashboard once CI finishes.
